part.text:
The robot followed the corridor through all its corners and is now stopped in front of the red wall. The sonar read about 0.55 m on the right and 1.06 m on the left. I then called rest, so the robot is crouched with its motors off.

It didn't fall at any point. The last camera image, taken after the crouch, shows the red wall ahead with a small gap of floor in front of it.

The right-hand wall was close for a stretch near the end, and the robot's collision protection kept stopping it. I got past by sidestepping left.
